source_title: Lifeway Foods® to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 12, 2026
source_excerpt:
MORTON GROVE, Ill. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lifeway Foods, Inc. (Nasdaq: LWAY ) ("Lifeway" or "the Company"), the leading U.S. supplier of kefir and fermented probiotic foods, today announced it will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on November 12, 2026 after market close.
A live conference call and Q&A session with management, discussing these results with additional comments and details will be made available through the "Investor Relations" section of the Company's website at https://lifewaykefir.com/webinars-reports/ at 4:30 p.m. ET on November 12, 2026. Those interested in participating in the live call can dial 1-877-407-9716 or 1-201-493-6779. The webcast will be archived and available for replay.
About Lifeway Foods, Inc. Lifeway Foods, Inc. is the brand that introduced kefir to generations of American consumers. For 40 years, Lifeway has defined authentic, real kefir in the U.S. market while building the expertise, consumer trust and scale that support its category leadership. The Company has earned recognition as one of TIME's America's Growth Leaders, one of Fortune's Fastest-Growing Companies, Dairy Foods' 2025 Processor of the Year, one of Forbes' Best Small Companies and an honoree on Inc.'s 2025 Best in Business list in the Best Challenger Brands category.
